name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Trout goes with Grayreach if and only if Maggot goes with Trout.
Cody, Grayreach, and Nightcrawler belong to different catches.
Either Dale goes with Minnow or Grayreach goes with Cody.
Between Bass and Catfish, one goes with Birchpool and the other with Grayreach.
Bass goes with exactly two of Cody, Grayreach, and Minnow.
